## Added

- **`/readyset <idea>` — no `--idea` needed.** Bare text after the flags starts a grilling turn; `--idea` still works too. Flags go before the idea (`--lang Indonesian let users export CSV`).
- **Readyset runs your tests itself.** Instead of trusting a self-reported note, Readyset runs the project's own test command — auto-detected (npm/pnpm/yarn/bun, `go test`, `cargo test`, `pytest`, `make test`) or set with `readyset.verify.command` — once right after you approve as a baseline, then again when the model signals done, at settle, and before an on-demand `/readyset --review`. Only a failure that wasn't already in the baseline holds anything up; the gate tells you up front what command Approve lets Readyset run. `_Verified:` notes are only required when nothing can be detected, or you set `readyset.verify.requireNotes: true`.
- **The execution handoff closes on its own.** The model calls `readyset_done` when it's finished — `done` once every task is checked and Readyset's own test run passes, `blocked` with the exact question if it needs you. No more guessing at a stalled pause: an unfinished execution simply stays paused until it signals done, every task gets checked, or your next `/readyset` supersedes it.
- **`readyset.phaseBudget.minutes`** caps how long an Explore or Propose turn can run (default 20); past it, Readyset aborts the turn and keeps whatever it wrote.

## Changed

- Execution still runs on the model you pinned (`--phase-model apply=…`, else `--model`), restored once it settles.
- Grilling still runs on the grill model (`--phase-model grill=…` / `readyset.model.phases.grill`, else your run pin).
- Leaner, lane-aware prompts; the fast lane's review only reads what the fast lane writes.
- The README benchmark table is withdrawn until a clean rerun on this version.

## Fixed

- `/readyset --review <id>`'s diff-size trigger now measures against the approve-base commit instead of always seeing an empty diff.
- The grill → propose hand-over no longer crashes.
- `- _Verified: …` written as a sub-bullet counts as a verification note.
- The phase log no longer records a grill model that wasn't used, or an unbalanced archive event.

## Install / Update

```
npx readyset-flow install
npx readyset-flow update
```
or with `bunx` in place of `npx`.

The extension module is referenced in place, so updating the package is enough — no re-install needed.

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/fresp/readyset-flow/compare/v0.16.0...v0.17.0
